props.name: SM_Cart_Rac
props.units: metres, Unity axes (x right, y up, z forward = cart front); origin = ground under the big-wheel axle
props.material: M_HanoiMoto (vehicle atlas Export/Vehicles/Textures/T_MotoAtlas.png + T_MotoAtlasData.png, palette cells only); paint tint where UV is in the PAINT cell

rig.hierarchy: FBX is flat: SM_Cart_Rac_Rig > Cart_Body_LODn, Cart_WheelL_LODn, Cart_WheelR_LODn, Cart_Caster_LODn, Cart_CasterWheel_LODn (origins on their pivots), HAND_L/R. In Unity: CasterWheel goes under the Caster pivot; Caster swivels about Y, wheels spin about local X.
